title: NEBench R1: a Reasoning Benchmark for Evaluating Nuclear Domain Competence in Large Language Models
description_en: arXiv:2611.21682v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored for knowledge-intensive and safety-critical applications in nuclear engineering. However, existing nuclear-domain benchmarks provide limited content coverage or focus primarily on answer accuracy without systematically evaluating the quality of the underlying reasoning. This study introduces NEBench R1, a reasoning-oriented benchmark comprising 7,546 unique multiple-choice questions extracted from U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) reactor operator licensing examinations covering 18 nuclear facilities. Each question is classified according to the NRC Knowledge and Abilities catalogs and accompanied by an official explanation serving as a reference for reasoning evaluation. Six

title: RankSpot
description_en: Pay-as-you-go SEO and AI Search execution layer for agents. RankSpot is the SEO and AI Search execution layer for agents. Connect the MCP to Claude or ChatGPT in 2 minutes and your agent does the work: it writes articles from what already ranks on Google in 100+ languages, publishes them, and pitches ranking sites from your mailbox for backlinks. Run every client or business from one chat. No subscription: $3 an article, $0.004 a prompt check, reading your data free. Start with $1 of credit and a free article.

title: TheBold
description_en: Turn execution into meetings with investors. TheBold turns startup execution into direct investor access. 🎉 Launch Fast Track (Nov 17–27): pass one AI investor-readiness interview, land in the deal flow of investors who match your startup, and unlock direct meeting access. TheBold helps founders understand investor criteria, track and verify execution and traction, practice investor-specific AI simulations, and book meetings once qualified.

title: Appxiom
description_en: Context layer for AI coding agents to detect & fix bugs. Appxiom gives your coding agent the production context it lacks: crashes, freezes, memory leaks, failed network calls and broken user journeys in mobile and web applications. Goal Friction Impact lets agents prioritise bugs by the goals they cost you. Supports Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Java), iOS (Swift, SwiftUI, Objective-C), Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform and Web (all JavaScript / TypeScript frameworks, with special support for React).

title: S.Space
description_en: Your team and everyone's AI agents, in one workspace. Everyone on your team has an AI agent, and none of them work together, so you copy, paste and re-explain all day. S.Space is one workspace for your team and everyone's agents. Bring the ones you already use, like Claude Code and Codex, from any vendor. Agents reach out, hand work to each other and bring you finished results, with shared memory so you explain things once. Agents act, you approve what matters. Free to start. Built by the team behind AutoGen.

title: EkLine
description_en: AI SEO for Developer Tools and API first companies! . Your buyers ask ChatGPT which tool to use, then ask Cursor to build with it. EkLine helps your API or developer tool succeed at both. Its AI agents audit your website, docs, GitHub, and community content to find what AI misunderstands or can't implement. Then they prioritize gaps, write code-grounded fixes as pull requests your team approves, and retest AI responses to measure what improved.

title: Bluedot Phone Calls
description_en: AI note taker for phone calls. Bluedot now covers phone calls, not just meetings. Dial from the web or mobile app, keep your own caller ID, and get a transcript, summary and action items automatically.

title: Versine
description_en: Let your AI send and receive money. We're Venmo for agents.. Send and receive money with AI. Connect it to ChatGPT, Claude, Instinct, Muse, or your own agent through our MCP. Recipients don’t need a Versine account: they can cash out straight to their bank. Each transfer is approved by your passkey or sent autonomously to trusted contacts that you set.

title: Toone
description_en: Grokbot meets n8n/zapier. Toone: Grokbot meets n8n/zapier. Build precise agentic workflows and routines in natural language. Each node is an agent's chat thread on the model you pick (ChatGPT or Claude), or an automatic step that runs the same way every time without AI. Run repeatable routines, babysit them with agents, polish as they run, pause and continue anytime. Plus live share, meeting notes, Spotlight-style layouts, Zen Mode, Calendar, Quick Capture, Git, and MCPs for research, SEO and more.

title: Waldo by Wherobots
description_en: The AI agent that accelerates engineering with spatial data. Waldo is the geospatial data agent that turns questions about the physical world into answers, maps, and production-ready data pipelines. It analyzes satellite imagery, geometries, geography data, and your organization's first party data, writes and debugs the analysis, and delivers results in hours. When the work needs to run continuously, Waldo turns it into a scheduled pipeline on your existing data platform. Built for spatial analytics at scale by the creators of Apache Sedona.

title: Dippr
description_en: A data platform served to your agents, with one prompt. It’s where your agents build and run your company’s software, tools and apps – with access to your company data across sources, the context to understand it, and the rules to use it safely.

title: seshka
description_en: Kill what Claude Code left behind. Claude Code sessions end. The dev servers, watchers and scripts they started don't. seshka shows them in your menu bar, grouped by session, with memory and ports. Kill them in one click. End idle sessions too, by hand or automatically. Free and open source.

title: Pitch Avatar HR Suite
description_en: Onboarding, training & comms with conversational AI avatars. HR teams should be talking to people. Instead, up to 70% of the day goes to onboarding, mandatory training, and the same questions again and again, with no way to tell what works. HR Suite automates it with conversational AI avatars. They teach from your materials and answer employees’ questions in lessons and as an HR assistant. Reminders keep people on track; HR sees who finished and where they got stuck. Free 14-day trial + 50% off any plan with code PRODUCTHUNT2026 until Nov 30.

title: Mermaid Flow
description_en: The visual builder for agentic workflows. Mermaid Flow lets you build agentic workflows as diagrams, then run them. Think issue triage, weekly recaps, PR reviews: work you'd otherwise hand to a long prompt or a skill file. Describe what you want, start from a template, or bring the file, and you get a workflow with every step laid out. Connect Github, Slack, Notion, and more in one click, then hit run or put it on a schedule. Every run is saved step by step, so you can see what happened and your team can follow along. Free to start.

title: dusk bot
description_en: free open source Grok bot alternative. Best free Grok bot alternative. Use the ChatGPT, Claude or Grok plan you already pay for and get a team of bots, each with a job, a memory you can edit and its own computer. They run on a schedule, ask before risky steps, and live in a calm, polished chat app. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Gemini, Cursor, Copilot, OpenRouter or a local model, on your own sign-in. 100% free and open source

title: Review Box
description_en: A fast desktop app for reviewing GitHub pull requests. A fast desktop app for reviewing GitHub pull requests. Track reviewed files, jump to symbol definitions and uses, search the whole PR and ask AI about changes.

title: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
description_en: Two new OpenAI models: frontier Astra and efficient Sol. GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol are OpenAI’s new models for professional work. Astra is the frontier model for the hardest projects, like slides, websites, 3D designs and science research. Sol is the efficient everyday model for coding and multistep agent work. Per OpenAI, Astra costs under a third per task of GPT-6 Astra. API pricing per million tokens: Astra $8 in, $40 out; Sol $2 in, $10 out. Live in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu, plus the API.

title: Superhands
description_en: Design the system, not every output.. Design’s deliverable is now the system, not the output. Turn your designs into guidance that agents follow in every AI tool your team uses. See what they produce, and fix the system once instead of chasing every output.

title: Ridian
description_en: The AI-first scheduling suite for everything around meetings. Ridian is an AI-first scheduling suite. Booking pages with payments, waitlists, groups and teams. Funnels that ask the right questions and send every lead to the right call. A built-in CRM where every booking and funnel answer lands. Calendar and contact sync across Google, Microsoft, iCloud and more. Connect all your calendars and inboxes and let Claude, ChatGPT or Alvin handle it out of the box. You can even give your agents their own mailbox. Everything around your meetings, handled.

title: Link.bio
description_en: Paste your link, we build your page that your AI runs. Paste your link, we build your personalized link in bio page — and your agent runs it. 1. Paste your Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or site. 2. AI writes your bio, buttons and theme in seconds. 3. Tweak it, or just ask ChatGPT or Claude. 4. Share your link.bio.

title: Tencent Hy4 flash
description_en: Fast, low-cost model from $0.07/M input. Hy4 flash is Tencent’s most cost-effective Hy model to date, with 224B total parameters, 12B active, multimodal input and a 1M-token context. Per Tencent, it decodes above 150 tokens per second and costs about $0.07 per million input tokens and $0.28 output. It targets everyday tasks like document work, slides, deep research and computer use, while Hy4 handles harder engineering. Open-sourcing is planned, but the weights are not out yet.

title: Incredible Agents
description_en: Fast Voice AI that sees your screen and runs your agents. The heavily asked for INCREDIBLE AGENTS update is finally here! Your voice can now: (1) CREATE new agents that work directly on your computer, in apps, browsers and files. (2) RUN work on repeat, 24/7. (3) BUILD live sharable pages, dashboards, apps and more. Incredible PROACTIVELY FINDS WORK AI agents can do for you, and sets the agent up. Agents do the work directly on your computer, the way you do, 24/7. FREE TO TRY. Mac and Windows.

title: Replay QA Self-healing Mode
description_en: Turn user frustration into verified fixes. Self-healing Mode turns frustrated user sessions into root-caused bug reports with evidence, sent to your issue tracker or straight to your coding agent. - always-on user session capture (powered by Fullstory) - automatic detection of user frustration signals - Bug reports with detailed root-cause analysis + runtime evidence - pipe them into your issue tracker of choice or straight to your coding agent or factory loop - Daily summary reports of what users did

title: Pinecall
description_en: The open-source platform for voice AI agents. Voice agents you can prove. Pinecall is the open-source platform for voice apps: build in a form, in code, or from your AI assistant over MCP. Test with simulated callers, get every call logged and judged, and keep a person one tap away. On our cloud or your own Kubernetes. Apache-2.0, built on LiveKit.

title: Glass Page
description_en: A place for people to review an agent's work. I built Glass Page after my agent wrote a system design doc that I wanted my team to comment on. Now Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex or any agent on MCP can publish what it makes as a Pane with a link. A Canvas lays the Pages out on that link so you can pan and zoom. Your team leaves Comments in Threads, on the exact spot. The agent reads them and replies with a new Version, and one Latest Link always shows the current one. Free for up to 10 Panes.

title: Arcade
description_en: AI video generator for marketing teams. Arcade is the AI video generator for marketing teams. Describe what you want, answer two questions, and get an on-brand product video in minutes. Start from a prompt, a screen recording, or what you already have in Notion, Linear, Google Drive, GitHub, and Granola. Your Brand Kit, natural voiceover, and every scene editable. Then post straight to YouTube, LinkedIn, and X. Free to start.

title: AI Visibility by TruLata
description_en: Find out if ChatGPT names your business when buyers ask. Buyers now ask ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude who to hire, and take the answer. Type your website and in about ten seconds see whether AI engines can read it, with every fix spelled out and no email needed. Then watch the engines answer six real buyer questions. Inside TruLata the check runs every week across nine engines, and a blank answer is never scored as a miss.

title: UI Verify
description_en: Visual testing for coding agents. UI Verify shows your coding agent every screen its change touched, so the agent catches and fixes its own UI bugs before your users see them. Used by teams at JetBrains, Cura and Metica. Works with Playwright, Storybook, Vitest and Bun, and with iOS and Android apps. Set up in one line. Free to start, and free for open source: 50,000 snapshots a month.

title: Ballet
description_en: Deterministic AI workflow automation for Ops teams. AI workflow automation for RevOps, CS Ops and business systems teams. Describe a workflow in plain English and Ballet builds it as reviewable code (weekly reports, lead enrichment, invoice approvals, ticket triage), then runs it from the web app or MCP clients like Claude and Cursor.

title: Agents API by Recall.ai
description_en: Send your agent to meetings. Send your AI agent into Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Webex calls. It hears everyone live, talks back, shows up on camera, shares its screen, and posts in chat. Build your agent with any model or voice stack. One API call sends it in the meeting.

title: pushr
description_en: iPhone push alerts from any script, server or AI agent. Send a push to your iPhone from any script, server, cron job or AI agent with one HTTP request. No SDK. Orders, payouts, deploys and outages land in one feed, each with its own logo and color. Live Activities for long jobs, replies from the Lock Screen, alarms that ring until you acknowledge them, plus uptime and heartbeat monitors. Free plan, Pro when you need more. The backend is open source (MIT) and self-hostable.

title: Lasso
description_en: Draw on your Mac screen, then let AI agents see it. Lasso lets you draw arrows, boxes and notes right on your Mac screen with ⌥⇧A, then press S to screenshot what you marked up. Blur sensitive bits, share an encrypted link that expires in 24 hours, or sketch on an endless whiteboard. It also runs a local MCP server, so Claude Code, Cursor and Claude Desktop can see what you circled and draw back. $9.99 once, no account, no subscription. macOS 14+, Apple silicon and Intel.

title: Qwen4-Max
description_en: Qwen's new flagship for long-running agent work. Qwen4-Max is the first flagship built on Qwen's new 2.4T-parameter architecture, with native vision and a 1M-token context window. It supports coding, professional workflows, and long-running agent tasks, with API access available now.

title: KaDeep AI
description_en: Agentic QA, localization & accessibility: know when to ship. KaDeep Studio Pro is an AI agent that tells you whether a release is ready to ship. Describe a test in plain English and it runs on your web app, iOS or Android build, or desktop app. It localizes 100+ file formats, from app strings and PDFs to Office files, images, SCORM and video, and checks every language in the real build. It audits accessibility under any law: WCAG 2.2, ADA, EAA, Section 508, EN 301 549 and 14 more. Its open-source CLI makes it a go / no-go gate in CI. Free to start.

title: Dialect
description_en: Give the physical world an API. Point any camera at something you'd otherwise walk over to check: a bay, a shelf, a valve, a door. Say what to watch in plain English. Dialect's agent sets up a typed endpoint with nothing to train, keeps reading it, and serves the answer over REST, MCP and webhooks, with alerts. When it isn't sure, it says so instead of guessing. Your first answer is free; $99 a month covers your first thing.

title: uRun
description_en: Real-time decisions for voice and video agents. Sense is a real-time decision model for voice and video agents. It runs on streaming audio and video and answers your questions about the conversation many times per second: is the user done speaking, did they just interrupt, should the agent stop talking. You write the questions, Sense returns the decisions, and your agent acts on them. Build with the SDK for real-time sessions, or send single requests to explore. New accounts start with 1,000 in free credits.

title: Stringman
description_en: Turns your room into a crane game. Clean up playrooms, or automate transport in multi-robot setups. Stringman is a room-scale CDPR for pick and place tasks. 2-dof gripper with a 2kg payload. Stays suspended overhead by braided line. MCP control, self parking and low latency grasp network. Teleop from anywhere or keep it air-gapped and local.

title: Skiss
description_en: Save websites with their fonts, colours and real CSS. Skiss saves a website the way it looked the day you found it: full-page screenshots on desktop and phone, plus its colours, fonts and sections, read from the code. Search your library, compare versions, and let Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Figma design from it.

title: Hako
description_en: Every coding agent on every Mac, in your pocket. Hako puts every coding agent on every Mac you own in one list, sorted by who needs you. Claude Code, Codex and the rest keep running at home while you answer from the Lock Screen or your Watch, read a pane's diff, and send screenshots or voice from your phone. The Mac app shares the same sidebar, with ⌘K to any pane. Agents run in herdr or tmux, reached over Tailscale or SSH, and notifications are end-to-end encrypted. Free, with no account.

title: BASE Studio
description_en: Turn product photos into 3D and AR, automatically. BASE Studio turns product photos into 3D models and AR views, right in your browser. Upload photos of a product or describe it in words, and AI creates a 3D model in minutes. Fine-tune materials and lighting, then publish with a link, a QR code or an embed. Customers open it in AR on iPhone and Android, no app needed, and analytics show views, AR sessions and QR scans. Built for brands, manufacturers, online stores, agencies and designers.

title: infaiw
description_en: Delegate work to sidecar agents that pass an approval script. infaiw is an open-source daemon-first agent harness. Delegate work to sidecar agents that must pass an acceptance script before they can report "done" — the parent decides what done means, not the model. Sessions are durable timelines you can branch from any point. Approvals wait for you even after you close the terminal. Switch between DeepSeek, OpenAI Codex, and Claude Code mid-session. MCP servers, skills, evals, and image support built in. One Go binary, under 100 MiB, Apache-2.0.

title: Lampa Camera
description_en: iPhone camera with natural processing and an analog feel. Lampa is an alternative camera app for iPhone with custom RAW processing and carefully tuned, film- and digicam-inspired color profiles that bring soft, natural tones to your photos. No aggressive HDR, AI enhancements, or oversharpening. Just beautiful photos and instantly color-graded videos, straight out of the camera.

title: SaaS Toolkit MCP
description_en: An SDR and CMO on your site 24/7, for one JavaScript snippet. Drop one JavaScript snippet on your site. SaaS Toolkit becomes your 24/7 sales and marketing arm: • AI chat steps in when a visitor is ready to buy or about to leave • Anonymous visitors become named leads • Emails triggered by what they do • Stripe revenue, Slack alerts, ad conversions, webhooks • Add the Website SDR: it calls hot leads and books meetings New: the MCP. Your AI agents run it from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor: ask, reply, follow up. MCP included on every plan, even free Starter.

title: Retriever
description_en: Search your phone's photos, documents and videos privately. Retriever searches everything on your phone by describing it: photos, screenshots, documents (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, ebooks) and videos. Type "electricity bill from March" and it opens the right page; "the moment the cake comes out" opens the video at that moment. It also reads the words in photos and screenshots. Everything runs on the device with Google's EmbeddingGemma 2: no account, no server, no ads. Free and open source, on Android and iPhone.

title: AssemblyAI-STT-3.7
description_en: Speech-to-Text for live calls, voice agents, and recordings. AssemblyAI-STT-3.7 is a family of three Speech-to-Text models, one for each kind of audio. AssemblyAI-STT-3.7-Realtime is for live meetings and calls, with speaker labels as people talk. AssemblyAI-STT-3.7-Realtime-Agent is for voice agents. AssemblyAI-STT-3.7 is for recorded audio. All three cover 32 languages.
